headline: COL @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 4.02 at LAA 5.66, with a projected total of 9.68. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: COL moved +0.26 runs while LAA moved +0.78, changing the projected margin by -0.52 runs. The projected total climbed +1.03, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tomoyuki Sugano has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Troy Johnston, Nolan Schanuel, Tyler Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Braxton Fulford, Edouard Julien because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
